## Slice contract

What coherent behavior/infrastructure change does this PR make?

## Why now

Which roadmap phase or defect justifies the change?

## Ownership / architecture

- [ ] I identified the authoritative owner of any new cross-system state.
- [ ] I did not introduce a new global/Autoload without explicit justification.
- [ ] Simulation does not depend on UI.
- [ ] UI does not become authoritative gameplay state.
- [ ] Any project-wide architecture decision is documented by ADR.

## Health

- [ ] Architecture guard passes.
- [ ] Godot import succeeds.
- [ ] Automated tests pass.
- [ ] Main scene boots.
- [ ] `docs/state.md` reflects what actually exists.
- [ ] Canon/roadmap docs were updated only if their truth changed.

## Persistence

- [ ] No save-schema change.
- [ ] OR schema/migration/fixtures were updated deliberately.

## Owner-facing result

Describe what the non-coding project owner should test or observe, if anything.
